description: This file contains a PHP trait 'LayoutBuilderEntityFormTrait' used in Drupal's Layout Builder module. It provides common methods for entity forms related to layout building, including form ID generation, message container building, redirect handling, action building, and save tasks.

methods.name: getBaseFormId
methods.description: Returns the base form ID, combining entity type ID with a suffix.

methods.name: buildMessageContainer
methods.description: Builds a render array for displaying status messages.

methods.name: redirectOnSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by redirecting to the layout builder URL.

methods.name: getSectionStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the section storage object for the current form.

methods.name: buildActions
methods.description: Builds and modifies the actions array for the form, including save, discard, and preview toggle.

methods.name: saveTasks
methods.description: Performs tasks during save, such as deleting temporary storage, adding status messages, and redirecting.
